Dog intelligence can be ranked based on how quickly different breeds learn and respond to commands. Border Collies, Poodles, and German Shepherds are considered the most intelligent because they learn new commands very quickly. Breeds like Golden Retrievers, Dobermans, and Labradors are also highly capable but may need slightly more repetition. Other breeds such as Corgis, Beagles, and Pugs require more practice to learn tasks. At the lower end, breeds like Afghan Hounds, Chow Chows, and Bulldogs tend to need the most repetitions to understand commands.
